name: On gfx906, float16 activations overflow to inf and vLLM emits runs of '!!!!' instead of tokens; bf16 weights are rejected for MXFP4 and fp32 activation compute is the only reported fix, at a large throughput cost
symptom: Generation degrades into runs of the literal character '!' - described in the community as output that 'spits !!!!' - rather than a crash or a clean error. Reported on: Qwen3.5 (AWQ, on 4x MI50) where 'using dtype fp16 generated garbage "!!!!"' until fp32 activations with fp16 KV cache were used; Qwen3.6 on llama.cpp where 'on prefill it gets corrupt and start spitting !!!!... and it's not deterministic'; and DeepSeek-V3.2 MLA sparse at 60k+ context on 16 MI50, which 'worked fine during the whole context (60k+ tok) without garbage output' only after the same fp32-compute change. A related silent-corruption variant produces fluent but wrong text that loops or drops content rather than exclamation marks.
root_cause: Not established from first-party sources. The community working hypothesis is fp16 dynamic-range overflow in the attention/MLP activation path; gfx906 has no bf16 hardware path in the same way CDNA does, and one member noted that weights are de-quantised back to fp16 for essentially every quant, then consumed with fp16 dot2 instructions. Working against this: one member with NVIDIA cards reports seeing the same non-deterministic prefill '!!!!' on vLLM + Qwen3.6, and argues it is NOT gfx906-specific.
workaround: Run fp32 compute with fp16 KV cache for long-context serving, at a documented cost: the reporter attributes lost throughput specifically to 'some FP32 computations I have to set to avoid garbage output at high context'. For MXFP4 quantisation, vLLM refuses float16 outright with 'float16 cant be used with mxfp4 quantization, only bfloat16 can'. For Gemma-family models on fp16, a community patch clamps hidden states to [-65504, 65504] in the decoder layer (mirroring a transformers upstream fix) to stop gemma3 returning empty responses. The gfx906 fork maintainers also report an independent dtype rule: official GPTQ quants need fp32 compute plus fp16 KV cache, where the fp16-activation build produced garbage.
notes: MIXED EVIDENCE, deliberately not marked verified. FOR: five independent people in the export hit fp16 corruption of some kind on gfx906 (beny4088, tipolosko_, droptablefoxes, aceshigh555, mixa3607), and two of them found a specific mitigation. AGAINST: droptablefoxes explicitly reports the same '!!!!' on NVIDIA cards and says it is not gfx906 specific, and aceshigh555's llama.cpp build had to be MODIFIED in a container to make Qwen3-class models pass a benchmark at all. So this record establishes that the failure is real, recurrent, and expensive on gfx906, and that the fp32 mitigation works - it does NOT establish that gfx906 is the cause. Confidence is set accordingly. A genuinely reliable detector is reported by blivioniag: check that the drafting acceptance rate and the output text are both sane, because 'sometimes you see the drafting going at 100% acceptance and it's all garbage output'.
